newsitem.title: USA: Fields Aircraft says returned to profit.
newsitem.headline: Fields Aircraft says returned to profit.

text.p: Fields Aircraft Spares Inc said preliminary second-quarter sales reached a record $2.9 million, up 142 percent from $1.2 million last year, and the company returned to profitability in the quarter.
Fields also said sales for the first six months reached $5.0 million, up 92 percent over first-six-month 1996 sales of $2.6 million and versus $5.7 million for the entire year of 1996.

"We had projected the company would return to profitability in the third quarter. We are now extremely pleased to be able to report the return to profitability has been accelerated, and that although the first six months of 1996 will still show a loss...it was profitable in the second quarter," said Lawrence Troyna, chief financial officer.
